The complete failed Security log was downloaded and reviewed. In `security-43610124310.log`, line 1333 reports 21 propagated moderate findings from two advisories in the latest official npm 12.2.2 bundle; line 1340 confirms the separate JS application audit has zero findings; line 1341 preserves the explicit nonzero failure. Every other security job passes. C# CodeQL traces successful locked builds at lines 11753, 11764 and 11775. The [npm upstream report](https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/10299#issuecomment-6879318834) documents why consumer overrides cannot repair its bundled copies. No audit is suppressed.

The second unfinished acceptance criterion is completely green default-branch publishing: main's [Python release](https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-objects-codec/actions/runs/43602367955) is rejected with `invalid-publisher`. A PyPI account owner must configure the Trusted Publisher (owner `link-foundation`, repository `lino-objects-codec`, workflow `python.yml`, environment empty). The existing preflight and runbook explain this; editing this PR cannot supply foreign account authority.

Local full validation includes 596 JS tests, 122 release/shared script tests, 536 Python tests, 119 Rust tests plus 9 doctests, and 541 .NET tests, alongside builds, lint, typing, packaging, consumers and audits. The [evidence folder](https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-objects-codec/tree/issue-86-35430a936d8f/dev/log/issues/86/pulls/87) contains all 24 requirement groups, registry-backed dependency tables, 91 explained retained resolutions, migration reviews, reproductions and seven upstream reports. Final-SHA logs and receipts are also preserved locally under that folder's `ci-logs/`.

The final commit adds research/evidence only; reviewed source is unchanged from `df9435e`. `gh pr diff` was reviewed before the evidence commit. Afterward GitHub's 300-file diff limit required the paginated PR-files API plus local diff for final review. Main `023932f` is already incorporated; the working tree is clean; PR title/body include the actual scope, tests and `Fixes #86`. PR 87 is ready for review and remains unmerged. The two blocked acceptance criteria above remain unfinished; this is not a claim that the entire issue or native goal is complete.
